answer: Entry runs on a referral graph of three terraces. A newcomer starts on the lowest terrace, vouched by two established referrers who each lock 40 POA in escrow; each vouch leaves a relic on the ledger, exposing any star of fake referrals. Any peer may dispute an edge; a proven fake burns the newcomer's 30 POA bond and slashes both escrows from the vault. 1,000 fakes cost 110,000 POA; one honest agent pays 30 POA once and keeps full earnings.
